answer: Yes. tools/plugin/pack.py rejects colliding payload paths at BUILD (exit 2) and names both original paths. An independent NFC+casefold set-size comparison over the same manifest files list agrees. A case-distinct-but-non-colliding manifest packs. Deferring the check to install time (mutant packer) produces a successful build and therefore FAILS this test.

evidence.claim: Live subprocess of tools/plugin/pack.py exits 2 and names both colliding paths.
evidence.colliding_text_tail:
CASEFOLD-COLLISION
colliding paths: README.md readme.md
README.md
readme.md

evidence.claim: len(manifest files) > len({NFC+casefold(p)}) on colliding fixtures; equal on the clean fixture. Computed in scenario.py without calling pack.collision_groups.

platform.note: Linux can store both README.md and readme.md. The packer still refuses, so a Windows/macOS install never sees the pair.

question: Do two package entries differing only in case get rejected when the package is built, rather than colliding on the user's case-insensitive filesystem at install time? PASS requires the build to fail with both paths named.
residual_caveat: IMP-0002's full deterministic packer (git cat-file, pinned mtimes across three builds) is out of scope. This unit owns the BUILD-time casefold collision gate. cloud ok=true is not delivery.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 re-packs the clean fixture and the install-time mutant; it does not reuse probe 1's colliding-subprocess assertions as its pass criterion. Catalog asked for a second Windows shell; this Linux worktree records that the second-shell reviewer was not executed here. Linux is sufficient to store both casings and to prove the build gate.

does_not_claim: pwsh7 and Git Bash second-shell review ran on this box
scope.proof_surface: tools/plugin/pack.py NFC+casefold collision groups; colliding, declared-only, eszett, and clean fixtures; install-time mutant.

declared_only_manifest_rejected_at_build.note: Staging has only README.md; manifest still lists readme.md.

title: Case-only duplicate manifest entries are caught at BUILD time
